# ghost/poet-assistant

Poet Assistant (F-Droid): an offline rhyming dictionary, thesaurus and dictionary. Look up a word and read its rhymes, synonyms and antonyms or its definitions. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/poet-assistant
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/poet-assistant open_poet --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/poet-assistant lookup --device <serial> --param word=<word>
ghost skill run ghost/poet-assistant get_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_poet`: Open Poet Assistant
- `lookup`: Find words that rhyme with love
- `get_results`: Show the current Poet Assistant results
